dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: Crabs, obviously. Don't you think it's cute, how they walk sideways?

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: And they're even harder to catch than fish! Hey, since you're so interested, you might as well take 'em. Here.

dialogues.speaker: Jill
dialogues.text: I can always catch more, it's no big deal.
